subject.title: [Feature]: Support to edit system prompt template

question: Should OpenClaw expose user-editable OpenClaw-owned system prompt sections such as Safety, Tool Call Style, Control, or Self-Update, and if so through which trusted contract?
rationale: This changes who can rewrite safety and operational guidance that currently lives in core, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Approve a narrow opt-in section contract
options.body: Define the allowed editable section ids, precedence against provider/hook contributions, file or schema location, and required docs/tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep existing hooks/provider overlays only
options.body: Close or document this direction as intentionally unsupported for core sections while pointing users to before_prompt_build, agent:bootstrap, and provider-owned overlays.

options.title: Split into narrower decisions
options.body: Track identity, additive rules, and safety-section overrides separately so each can be approved or rejected with smaller blast radius.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow opt-in section contract
recommendation.body: Define the allowed editable section ids, precedence against provider/hook contributions, file or schema location, and required docs/tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current provider-owned prompt contribution model and has already reviewed this issue as a product/security follow-up.
